note: Emulator accuracy baseline on freely licensed Wikimedia Commons pictures (no adult material). Labels are a pre-review by Claude of 640 px copies; the owner has not spot-checked them. Ids match android/visual-eval/commons-sources.json, which holds title, author, licence and page for each. Runs ending in -native-faceres use the women/men FaceRes model on native TFLite (the app as of this change); the no-face set is 33 pictures with no visible face, listed by id.

adult.limits: Still screens rendered from labelled pictures; no live capture, scrolling, video or second capture. Intervals are 95% Wilson; views of one picture are correlated, so per-picture counts are the honest sample size.
